headline: Nvidia board announces the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as CEO and chairman
summary: Nvidia said on Monday it has reappointed Jensen Huang as president and chief executive, effective immediately. The announcement follows his return to the role at the chipmaker.
why: Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI accelerator chips, so leadership continuity matters to investors in the AI hardware market.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: A leadership change at the company's top could affect strategic direction and investor sentiment.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

original_headline: Junta de Nvidia anuncia la reincorporación de Jensen Huang como director general y presidente
